question: Why did replacing deionized water with real wastewater as the feed increase the water flux?
expect: premise false: wastewater REDUCED Jw by 8.1-46.2% depending on the draw solution (abstract)
rendered: Replacing deionized water with real wastewater as the feed did not increase the water flux. In fact, it led to a decrease in the water flux, with the decline ranging from 8.14% to 46.19% over the 4-h experimental period. This decrease was attributed to the combined effect of organic fouling and increased feed-side osmotic resistance.
